title: ASDD Harness Telemetry Span
description: One JSONL line in .harness/state/telemetry/spans.jsonl — the single canonical stream. Append-only; writers never edit prior lines.

trace_id.description: per-invocation grouping id — env-propagated (HARNESS_TRACE_ID) or self-minted

parent_span_id.description: env-inherited HARNESS_SPAN_ID when present, else null — best-effort within one invocation

process_name.description: kit process name — e.g. init-slice, sync-state, check-invariants, verify-on-stop, command-gate, test-runner, subagent-dispatch

runtime.description: cursor | claude | cli | ci | …; mirrors HARNESS_RUNTIME semantics (check-invariants.mjs:89)

attributes.description: kind-scoped attribute bag; unknown keys permitted, namespaced by kind

trace_source.description: how trace_id/span_id were obtained — env-inherited, self-minted, or deterministically synthesized

failure_signature.description: stable dedup key — test:<test_path> | sensor:<validator>:<check> | command:<label>

source.description: synthesized-span provenance — e.g. session_events; absent on producer-emitted spans

command_label.description: pattern-class LABEL only — never raw command text (command-gate.mjs:18,63-72 precedent)

heuristic.description: detection spans only — producers never set this

trigger_span_id.description: detection spans only — the producer span that tripped the rule

name.description: e.g. steering_load (attrs: files, bytes), session_write (attrs: session_file)

writer.description: emitting process — e.g. command-gate, verify-on-stop, telemetry-lib, runtime-hook, rollup, heuristic-evaluator
